features.name: File browsing and directory navigation
steps: Use the breadcrumb/path to confirm the current location
Switch to another directory and then back
features.expected: The current directory state must be maintained correctly; the parent directory .., the path display, and the empty-directory state should all be correct; the back key and the directory-back behavior must be distinguished; the path state must not be lost by switching the bottom tabs

features.name: Create a file and persist it
steps: Verify that the content still exists
features.expected: Test new-file naming, file extensions, default format, and save state; empty files and existing duplicate names should give reasonable feedback; the list should update immediately after saving

features.name: File editing, Undo/Redo, and reloading
features.expected: Distinguish the in-memory editing state from the on-disk state; the Undo/Redo stack must be correct; when unsaved content is overwritten by a refresh there should be clear behavior

features.name: File deletion and list synchronization
steps: Verify that it disappears from the list
Confirm the file no longer appears
features.expected: Deletion should act on real local files; after deletion the file browser, search results, and recent records must not continue showing invalid objects

features.name: Sorting files and showing hidden files
steps: In a directory containing several files and folders
Select by name, date, file size, and MIME type respectively
features.expected: The sort result order must genuinely change; "folders first" and the primary sort condition should combine; the list should change immediately after toggling hidden files

features.name: File search and search scope
steps: Create several files containing the same keyword in a multi-level directory
features.expected: File-name search must be distinguished from content search; the depth limit and ignore directory/file rules must be correct; search results must locate real files

features.name: Notebook / QuickNote / To-Do storage locations
steps: Set the notebook directory, QuickNote file, and To-Do file paths
Enter the three entries from the bottom navigation respectively
Return to the file browser to confirm the actual file location
features.expected: The three entries correspond to different fixed files or directories; the path settings must persist; merely doing a UI jump without really changing the underlying file is not allowed

features.name: QuickNote rapid-note workflow
steps: Use the quick bar to insert headings, lists, bold, quotes, etc.
Return to QuickNote again to verify the content
features.expected: QuickNote is a fixed-file workflow; auto-save, focus, cursor position, format insertion, and content restoration after reopening must be verified

features.name: Basic todo.txt task workflow
features.expected: The task state should map to the actual todo.txt text semantics; the completed/incomplete state and the list display must be consistent

features.name: todo.txt date, context, and project semantics
steps: Enable "add completion date" and "attach context and project"
Verify the change in the completion date and tag text
features.expected: Test todo.txt-specific business logic; the completion-date format, tag preservation, and task state must be stable; it must not be merely a visual checkmark

features.name: Basic Markdown editing and preview
steps: Enter headings, paragraphs, bold, italic, quotes, unordered lists, ordered lists, code, etc.
Return to editing and continue modifying
features.expected: Edit and preview states must sync in both directions; the Markdown syntax must not be shown as raw text only; heading levels, list structure, and code blocks must be correct

features.name: Markdown rich-content workflow
steps: Insert links, images, local-file links, and tables in Markdown
Tap link/image-related elements to verify the behavior
features.expected: File-path resolution, local resource loading, URL links, and table rendering must all be correct; after an attachment is moved it should appear invalid rather than continuing to be cached as successful

features.name: Advanced Markdown rendering settings
steps: Turn "math formula rendering", "table of contents", "Front Matter", "new line = new paragraph", and "highlight end of line" on/off
Check the differences in preview and editing
features.expected: KaTeX/LaTeX, TOC, and Front Matter belong to the same Markdown rendering chain; settings changes must take effect immediately or after reopening and must not merely save the toggle

features.name: Multi-format file editing
steps: Create or open plain-text, Markdown, AsciiDoc, OrgMode, Wikitext/Zim, and todo.txt files respectively
features.expected: The core is choosing the correct edit/highlight/preview logic by format; different extensions and manually specified formats should behave consistently

features.name: Manual file-format switching
steps: Switch the format among Key-Value / plain text / AsciiDoc / Markdown / todo.txt / Wikitext-Zim / CSV / Embed binary / OrgMode
Return to the editor and observe the behavior change
features.expected: The same underlying file can be interpreted in different formats; the format state change must be verified rather than only the menu selection.

features.name: Structured text display such as CSV / Key-Value
steps: Create simple CSV and key-value text
features.expected: Focus on structured-format parsing and save consistency; special delimiters, empty fields, and newlines must not be corrupted

features.name: Wikitext / Zim link workflow
steps: Configure or enable "dynamic search of the notebook root directory"
features.expected: Notebook-root inference and internal-link resolution must be supported; a reasonable response is required when the file does not exist

features.name: The editor quick bar and ActionButton
steps: Use the quick bar repeatedly in edit mode: heading levels, bold, italic, lists, quotes, code, links, images, attachments, date, move up/down, etc.
features.expected: Each icon need not be a separate task, but the quick actions must be verified overall to genuinely modify the text; the custom order must persist

features.name: Editor layout and text-display settings
steps: Change the font, size, base color scheme, monospace code font, large headings, shortcut spacing, word wrap, centered text, start from the end, and tab indentation
Open a long document to verify the effect
features.expected: Several approximately equivalent display items merge into one; the key check is that the toggles and sliders genuinely affect the editor rather than merely recording the setting

features.name: Syntax highlighting and code display
steps: Toggle "disable spell check", "disable code-block highlighting", "monospace code font", and "hex color-code underline"
features.expected: Plain text, syntax tokens, and code blocks must be distinguished; the display state and the edited content must not contaminate each other

features.name: View mode and rendering customization
steps: Set the link color, right-to-left rendering, and view font size
Enter view mode in a supported document
features.expected: Edit-mode and view-mode configurations must be independent; RTL must not simply mirror the UI but change the text direction

features.name: HTML Head / Body injection
steps: Verify that the injected CSS/HTML/script has the corresponding effect on the preview
features.expected: Involves the rendering pipeline, HTML injection, and the preview WebView state; illegal content and empty values must be handled correctly

features.name: File sharing and export
steps: Verify that the editing state is not lost
features.expected: Android Intent behavior is observable logic; after returning, the file, cursor, and unsaved state must not break; different "share to-format" settings must take effect

features.name: Attachments, images, and templates/text snippets
steps: Configure the attachment folder name and the snippets/template directory
Preview and check the relative paths
features.expected: The core is file-system integration; attachments must be genuinely written/referenced; after switching the template directory the data source should change in sync

features.name: App behavior, theme, and security settings
steps: Toggle keep screen on, disable screenshots, Chrome Custom Tabs, and the startup page/start folder
Verify that these behaviors still work
features.expected: Verify the settings persistence and system-level behavior; the theme must genuinely change the UI; "disable screenshots" and "keep screen on" should have observable system effects

features.name: Configure backup and restore
steps: Verify that the theme, directories, and editor options are restored
features.expected: A typical cross-page, cross-file, cross-restart E2E; verify that the exported file genuinely exists, the import format is validated, abnormal JSON is handled, and the global state after restoring is consistent
